# @socketsecurity/sdk

> SDK for the Socket API client. 1 subpath exports, grouped by namespace.

Import any namespace by its subpath, e.g. `import '@socketsecurity/sdk/testing'`. Each link below points at the TypeScript declarations shipped in the package, where the full signature for that subpath lives.

## Top-level

- [@socketsecurity/sdk/testing](./dist/testing.d.mts)
